_readme: Copy to swarm.config.json (git-ignored) and point 'app' at the app you are testing. Lanes = AVD names in avdDir (create them with swarm-avd.ps1 create). Each lane has its own test login ('user', a user key in qa-kit targets.local.json) and 'notes' printed by phone.ps1 acquire. 'headless' (top level or per lane) boots without windows. Passwords never go here. Paths: forward slashes work on every OS (Windows: C:/src/...). avdDir empty = $ANDROID_AVD_HOME, else ~/.android/avd.
